spike_ext.plug_note: plug = USB Type-C plug overmold maximum per the USB-IF Type-C Compliance Document rev 1.2, p. 46: width 12.35 max, height 6.5 max, with a 6.65 mm plug in front of it. Any compliant cable fits; Type-C spec R2.0 Fig. 3-80 needs the seated overmold to clear the product surface, so the opening passes the overmold.
